description: B2B lead search: give a sector and a country (city optional), get back people currently working at matching companies - name, title, a real work email, and their company's name, domain (when known) and employee count. Async job - POST creates it, free status polling and result retrieval. Up to 25 leads per call. Try GET /company-leads/sample.

city.description: Optional city or region to narrow the search within the country, e.g. "Paris".

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code where the leads are located, e.g. "fr", "us".

sector.description: Industry/sector to search, e.g. "Software Development", "Marketing and Advertising".

name: company_leads

eta_seconds.description: Estimated seconds until the lead list is ready.

job_id.description: Identifier to poll for status and fetch the finished result.

title: Company Leads
